description.ja: 人とAIの“すれ違い”をテーマに挑む新規SFプロジェクト『SYNDUALITY』が本格始動！
description.en: A new science fiction project “SYNDUALITY” that challenges the theme of “passing each other” between humans and AI has started in earnest!

description.ja: 2023年放送開始予定のTVアニメ『SYNDUALITY』から、物語の鍵を握るメイガス「ノワール」がFigure-rise Standardで最速立体化！
description.en: From the TV anime "SYNDUALITY " scheduled to start broadcasting in 2023, Magus " Noir", who holds the key to the story, is transformed into three-dimensional figure at the fastest speed with Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: ■印象的なジャケットは着脱が可能。ハンドパーツの選択により袖から手をのぞかせるこだわりのポーズも劇中さながらに演出。
description.en: • The impressive jacket is removable. By selecting hand parts, you can create a special pose where your hand peeks out from the sleeve, just like in the movie.

description.ja: ■表情パーツが3種付属し、タンポ印刷・水転写式デカールによりキャラクターの表情を繊細に表現。
description.en: • Three types of expression parts are included, and the characters' expressions are delicately expressed with tampo printing and water transfer decals.

description.ja: ■各部の関節は自然なシルエットを意識しつつ、可動域を確保。
description.en: • The joints of each part maintain a natural silhouette while ensuring a range of motion.

description.ja: ■ディスプレイの自由度を向上させるプラモデルオリジナルのジョイントパーツや台座が付属。
description.en: • Comes with plastic model original joint parts and pedestal to improve display flexibility.

accessories.ja: ディスプレイ用ジョイントパーツ×１
